source_evidence: Exact player 'yes, we need to revise the taxation and the migration policies' accepts Aldren Voss's immediately preceding offer to remain as administrator, and directs revision of the tower's former coercive taxation and migration/settlement policies. Voss voluntarily accepts appointment as steward/administrator of western customs tower, separate from Hessa Marr's Silverward stewardship, at standard senior-manager5gp per actual working day (DM application of existing wage scale to player acceptance, not a player-specified special rate), paid work begins D336, common payday341 for recorded completed work, no wage earned or paid by this appointment. Voss is to manage peaceful transition, preserve existing records/assets, complete inventory and restitution accounting, verify Crown title/rights with appropriate institutions, pursue lawful business/settlement opportunities proactively, coordinate Hessa as appropriate without pooled accounts, and report actual funding and staffing needs. Existing seven retainers are NOT automatically hired or wage-charged; their independent choice/terms pending. No owner funding transfer, expense or business income. Voss puts forward PROPOSED local economic policy: free road passage, no unauthorized tolls, no additional House levy on wages, 5% of positive net profits of independent businesses only where lawfully and voluntarily agreed; first-year exemption from such House business levies for new enterprises, agreed fair agricultural rents adjusted for poor harvest, first-year House land-rent waiver for newly settled households where actually affordable and lawfully available land exists; public protection/infrastructure financed through actual estate revenue and lawful contributions. PROPOSED migration/settlement policy: peaceful newcomers of all species welcomed subject to applicable Crown law and legitimate residence/land rights, voluntary favorable leases/housing where actually available, proactive recruitment of craftspeople/merchants/agricultural workers, equal House protection for newcomers/current residents, free departure with rightful possessions, no compulsory labor/hereditary bondage/blood tribute. User has not approved proposed numeric rates, exemptions, additional authority or specific policy scope beyond requesting revision. These proposals do not create sovereign taxation, citizenship or immigration control, grant land, override existing rights, grant title or authority over surrounding district, waive Crown taxes, change other estate tax rules or impose new charges. Caul's previous unlawful dues have already been terminated; no replay or reimposition. No newly executed leases, sales, service, migrants, payroll, restitution or capital spending. Voss may prepare actual available parcel and cost/demand assessment; policy choices remain V's. Sources checked world/politics/human-states.md @77333e27aa5946858c824352e71af893aa6e1b96, institutions-wardens.md @7f50bf59e3b49c01cdb9d622a9238a1d33560d57, rules-estate-economy.md @619a568396bdef38ecfe7910227a3f61d2d677b9. Day335~15:40; all party resources unchanged, rations/feed remain zero, provisioning needed before travel. No roll for voluntary appointment and prospective policy discussion.
